description: Fetch full metadata for a single skill by its ID or slug. Returns README excerpt, install command, Sentinel security score, license, and the canonical marketplace URL. Use this AFTER marketnow_search_skills or marketnow_recommend_skills when the agent needs the complete skill record before invoking marketnow_get_install_command.

skill_id.description: Skill ID (e.g. mn-ai-00001) or slug (e.g. web-scraper). Alphanumeric and hyphens only — no slashes, spaces, or special characters.

name: marketnow_get_skill
